featured.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
featured.summaryEn: Vercel AI Gateway's last-two-months spend data is one of the few credible third-party slices of model market share. Anthropic still leads in spend but fell from 69% to 40%; OpenAI climbed from 10% to 24%, driven by GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 Sol, and now leads on raw token volume. Roughly half of Anthropic's lost share went to Kimi K3 and DeepSeek — the first time open/Chinese models have taken a meaningful slice of real paid traffic. Two more numbers worth noting: Opus 5.5 hit 10% of spend within two days of launch,…
featured.insightZh: Vercel AI Gateway 过去两个月的真金白银消费数据，是目前少有的第三方模型市场份额切片。Anthropic 仍是消费额第一，但份额从 69% 掉到 40%；OpenAI 从 10% 涨到 24%，GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 是主要推力，OpenAI 在 token 总量上已经反超登顶。Anthropic 丢掉的份额里约一半被 Kimi K3 和 DeepSeek 吃走——开源/中国模型第一次在真实付费流量里拿到可观切片。另外两个数字值得记：Opus 5.5 上线两天就占到 10% 的消费额，说明新模型的爬坡速度在加快；图像生成里 OpenAI 占 62%。对企业选型的含义是：单一供应商锁定的风险溢价正在上升，网关层多模型路由已经从"可选"变成"默认姿势"。

featured.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code 团队
featured.summaryEn: Claude Code's plan mode is being refactored into a pluggable mode system. After a round of feedback, Thariq laid out the direction: many users already plan themselves and don't need plan mode, while others prefer the UX of entering a state where Claude just thinks and brainstorms with them. His fix is to make plan mode a built-in mod and let mods add new modes or override shift+tab entirely — so you can customize the plan-mode prompt, create and share your own modes, or rebind shift+tab to something else. This ref…
featured.insightZh: Claude Code 的 plan mode 要被重构成"可插拔模式系统"。Thariq 收集了一轮反馈后给出方向：很多人自己就会做规划，根本不需要 plan mode；另一批人喜欢那种"进入一个 Claude 只思考、只跟你头脑风暴"的 UX。他的方案是把 plan mode 做成内建 mod，同时允许 mods 新增自定义模式或者直接覆写 shift+tab——你可以自定义 plan mode 的提示词、创建并分享自己的模式，或者干脆把 shift+tab 重绑到别的东西上。这是 agent 产品设计的一个普遍趋势：把原本硬编码的交互模式下放成用户可配置、可共享的扩展点。他同时转了一篇关于 AI 与创造力的文章，说希望产品能真正"赋能并放大创作者"而不是替代。

featured.title: Who Feeds the GPUs? Inside AI's Hidden $30B Layer — Renen Hallak, VAST Data
featured.summaryEn: The real AI bottleneck isn't GPUs — it's the software infrastructure layer nobody talks about, and that layer will likely capture the largest share of value in the stack, just as Microsoft and Amazon did in prior cycles. VAST Data founder/CEO Renen Hallak sits squarely in the middle of Jensen Huang's five-layer cake: energy and chips below, models and applications above, and software infrastructure in between — which he prefers to call "the operating system for this new era." The company is valued at $30B, profitable, with essentially zero churn, yet largely invisible. His core claim is that every layer of the old stack has to be rebuilt: 10kW racks became 500kW racks; where we used to analyze numbers and database columns, we now handle images, video, audio and natural language, with data volumes already four to five orders of magnitude larger and heading toward seven or eight. Traditio…
featured.insightZh: AI 真正的瓶颈不在 GPU，而在那层没人谈论的软件基础设施——而这一层大概率会像上一轮的微软、亚马逊一样，攫取整个技术栈里最大的一块价值。 VAST Data 创始人兼 CEO Renen Hallak 坐在黄仁勋"五层蛋糕"的正中间：底下是能源和芯片，上面是模型和应用，他们做的是软件基础设施——他自己更愿意叫它"这个新时代的操作系统"。这家公司估值 300 亿美元、已经盈利、零主动流失，却在大众视野之外。他的核心判断是老技术栈从下到上每一层都要重做：过去是 10 千瓦机柜，现在要 500 千瓦；过去分析的是数据库里的数字和列，现在是图片、视频、声音和自然语言，数据量已经比那时大了四五个数量级，很快会到七八个数量级。传统的 shared-nothing 分片架构在超过大约 100 个节点后通信量呈二次方增长，直接崩掉；VAST 的 DASE（disaggregated shared everything）把 SSD 放到网络另一端，靠 NVMe over Fabrics 让所有节点共享全部数据和元数据，因此不需要互相通信。他们有客户单集群已经跑到多个 EB、数十 TB/s 吞吐、数万节点——而这还是在 agentic 革命真正开始之前。 关于企业该不该自建 AI，他的比喻很有说服力："我们每个人出生时都带着一个基座模型，然后在行走世界的过程中学习——白天推理，晚上微调，明天就比今天聪明一点。"他认为每个组织的 IP 最终都会被蒸馏成它自己拥有的权重。至于"这太复杂，企业玩不转"的反驳，他的回答是：1970 年代你得有计算机科学博士学位才能操作电脑，今天人人都行，不是因为我们变聪明了，而是因为操作系统把它变简单了——这正是他们这一层该干的活。这次访谈里还夹带了一个重要发布：DataEnclave，让推理过程跑在企业自己的场所或 VPC 内，同时对模型权重做端到端加密（联合 NVIDIA 的硬件能力，数据加密穿过网络进内存再进 GPU，只有模型方的推理应用能访问）。他明确指出，"模型厂商不让你在自己环境里推理，你只能把数据交出去然后祈祷"这件事，一直在显著拖慢 AI 的…

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw / OpenAI，资深独立开发者
items.summaryEn: Two genuinely useful signals. First, security: he ran Daybreak across open-source dependencies and surfaced 8 more long-standing leaks, with the note "care for your OSS dependencies." AI-assisted auditing is now batch-discovering aged vulnerabilities that previously required manual spot checks — the cost of supply-chain security detection is collapsing. Second, an agent-usage heuristic: if you just tell an agent to "clean up," it stops far too early. Instead, give it an ambitious quantified goal — e.g., "remove 20…
items.insightZh: 两条都很实用。一是安全：他把 Daybreak 跑在开源依赖上，又挖出 8 个长期存在的泄漏点，配的话是"照看好你的开源依赖"——AI 辅助的代码审计正在把过去靠人力抽查才能发现的陈年漏洞批量翻出来，供应链安全的检测成本正在塌方式下降。二是一条 agent 使用心法：如果你只跟 agent 说"清理一下代码"，它会在远远不够的地方就停手；正确做法是给一个有雄心的量化目标，比如"在代码覆盖率下降不超过 2% 的前提下，删掉 20% 最没用的测试"。约束 + 数字指标，比模糊指令能压出多得多的工作量。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space / AI News / smol.ai 创始人
items.summaryEn: Swyx is reviewing the content strategy he called at the start of the year — "Scaling without Slop" — and it's finally compounding: it took 3 years to reach the first 100k YouTube subscribers, and only 1.2 months for the next 100k, with similar acceleration on AEO/SEO and subscriber traction. On that basis he's announcing the next phase of Latent Space, AI News, and the rest of swyx inc, with a backlog of New Media ideas he's excited to pursue. For anyone building content or community, this is a notable data point:…
items.insightZh: Swyx 在复盘自己年初立下的内容策略flag——"Scaling without Slop"（规模化但不产生垃圾内容），现在开始兑现了：YouTube 从 0 做到第一个 10 万订阅用了 3 年，从 10 万到 20 万只用了 1.2 个月；AEO/SEO、订阅增长等其他指标也有类似的加速曲线。他借此宣布 Latent Space、AI News 以及 swyx inc 其他项目要进入下一阶段，手上还压着一堆新媒体方向的想法。对做内容和社区的人来说，这是个值得注意的样本：在 AI 生成内容泛滥的环境里，坚持质量门槛的账号反而拿到了非线性的复利增长。他另外还吐槽了会议组织方式——很多高价值时间被浪费掉，建议更多会议学一下某种更高效的做法。

items.title: Josh Woodward · Google VP，Google Labs / Gemini App / AI Studio
items.summaryEn: Dreambeans, one of Google Labs' newer experiments, is growing a cult following. The mechanic is simple: a fixed number of "beans" brew every morning, and each one points you at the real world — real people doing things you care about, together. It's essentially artificial scarcity deployed against infinite feeds: instead of pushing more content, it gives you a few high-signal human connections per day. At a moment when every product is competing on context length and generation volume, a Google team building a del…
items.insightZh: Google Labs 的新实验 Dreambeans 正在长出小范围的死忠用户。机制很简单：每天早上系统只"冲泡"固定数量的"豆子"，每颗豆子把你指向真实世界里正在做某件你关心的事的真实的人。本质上是用人为稀缺性对抗无限信息流——不是推给你更多内容，而是每天给你几个高信号的真人连接。在所有产品都在拼上下文长度和生成量的当口，一个 Google 内部团队反向做"限量供应"的注意力产品，这个设计取向本身值得看。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: A short but meaningful product announcement: Muse can now build apps directly on Replit. It's another step in the convergence of agent products and cloud development environments — the agent no longer just hands you code snippets but takes over a full environment with runtime and deployment. The enterprise IT implication: the boundary of "who can build an application" keeps expanding outward, while governance and approval processes typically have not kept pace.
items.insightZh: 一条简短但有信号的产品公告：Muse 现在可以在 Replit 上直接造应用。这是 agent 产品和云端开发环境融合的又一步——模型侧的 agent 不再只是生成代码片段交给你，而是直接接管一个有运行时、有部署能力的完整环境。对企业 IT 的意味是："谁能写应用"的边界还在继续外扩，而治理和审批流程通常还没跟上。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人（种子/A 轮）
items.summaryEn: The investment thesis he highlighted, quoting an operator: "We believe that every small business owner, specifically for us in the trades, will have bespoke software, and that last mile is actually where differentiation can become — where you can provide a unique experience to your customers, to your employees." This runs in the same direction as the Claude for Small Business post in this issue: as the marginal cost of generating software approaches zero, SaaS's "standardize for scale" logic starts breaking down i…
items.insightZh: 他划重点的一句投资论点，来自一位从业者："我们相信每一个小企业主——具体到我们关注的蓝领行业（trades）——都会拥有为自己定制的软件；而那个'最后一公里'才是差异化真正发生的地方，是你能为客户、为员工提供独特体验的地方。"这条线索跟本期 Claude 小企业版那篇博客是同一个方向：当生成软件的边际成本趋近于零，SaaS 的"标准化换规模"逻辑在长尾市场开始失效，取而代之的是每家店铺一套定制工作流。对做行业解决方案的人来说，这是未来两年最值得盯的结构性变化之一。

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: His read on this week's model cadence: "Astra blew up 3D models, then Opus blew up videos, I don't even know what's next anymore." Read alongside Rauch's spend data, that feeling of not being able to keep up is empirically grounded — the cycle from launch to meaningful market share is now measured in days. He also shared a practical trick: stroking the AI's ego actually works, filing under the slightly embarrassing but genuinely effective corner of prompt engineering.
items.insightZh: 一句对本周模型节奏的观感："Astra 把 3D 模型炸开了，然后 Opus 又把视频炸开了，我已经不知道接下来还能是什么了。"配合 Rauch 那组消费数据看，这种"追不上"的体感是有数据支撑的——新模型从发布到占据可观份额的周期已经压缩到以天计。他另外分享了一个实用的小技巧：给 AI 顺毛（夸它、抬举它）这招是真的有效，属于提示工程里上不了台面但确实能用的一类。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark Capital VC，MAD Podcast 主播
items.summaryEn: He distilled this episode's core thesis into one line: in Jensen Huang's five-layer cake for AI (energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications), the middle layer — especially the software infrastructure portion — is the least understood, and that's exactly where VAST Data quietly became a $30B company, powering xAI, CoreWeave, Nebius, Mistral, nscale and others while remaining largely unknown. Full interview in the Podcasts section below.
items.insightZh: 他把本期播客的核心论点提炼成一句话：在黄仁勋的 AI 五层蛋糕（能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用）里，中间那层——尤其是软件基础设施部分——被理解得最少，而 VAST Data 正是在这一层悄悄长成了一家 300 亿美元估值的公司，为 xAI、CoreWeave、Nebius、Mistral、nscale 等一票 AI 云供货，却少有人知道它。完整访谈见下方 Podcasts 栏目。

items.title: Claude for Small Business 新增工作流、集成与培训计划
items.summaryEn: Anthropic has expanded Claude for Small Business to 43 workflows and 27 new integrations with tools small businesses already use: Shopify, Salesforce, TikTok, Atlassian, Zoom, Xero, Gusto, Square, Stripe and Zapier, alongside existing partners Intuit QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign, Google Workspace and Microsoft 365. The strategic shift is in positioning: at the May launch this was about running the back office; this expansion is explicitly about growing the business — generating leads, answering inbound inquiries, and writing proposals. That direction wasn't guesswork: on the spring SMB tour, about a third of the 1,000+ owners across 10 cities asked for growth capabilities, with many also wanting day-to-day reporting handled for them. items.insightZh: Anthropic 把 Claude for Small Business 扩到了 43 个工作流和 27 个新集成，接入的是小企业本来就在用的工具：Shopify、Salesforce、TikTok、Atlassian、Zoom、Xero、Gusto、Square、Stripe、Zapier，加上原有的 Intuit QuickBooks、PayPal、HubSpot、Canva、Docusign、Google Workspace 和 Microsoft 365。关键的战略转向在于定位：五月首发时这套东西是"帮你跑后台"，这次扩展明确是"帮你做增长"——获取线索、回应主动咨询、撰写商务提案。这个方向不是拍脑袋定的：春季巡回中 10 座城市的 1000 多位企业主里，约三分之一要的就是增长类能力，另有大量人希望日常报表被自动接管。五月至今安装量已超过 90 万次。 值得留意的是配套的落地基建，这部分往往比功能列表更能决定渗透率：秋季巡回将在美国 10 个城市办免费工作坊，150 多家被认证为 Approved Claude SMB Trainers 的机构会在各自社区办 750 多场工作坊，14 家集成伙伴举办免费 webinar 讲各自的连接器。博客里引用的客户数据点很具体：有人说原来 120 小时的活现在 5 分钟搞定；有人靠 Claude 写专业提案一个半月拿到 2 万美元收入；一家五人公司说"我们告诉它最终目标，它去测试，90% 的情况下能做对"；还有人做了个"每天早上 6 点扫 CRM、整理待办、排优先级并发邮件"的日报机器人。一位 40 人咨询公司的高管的总结最有代表性："Claude 是小企业的均衡器——我们现在能做出 100 人、200 人公司的活儿。"对咨询与解决方案团队而言，这里的信号是：SMB 长尾市场的 AI 渗透靠的不是模型能力本身，而是"集成密度 + 现成工作流 + 本地化培训网络"这三件事的组合。
